Apologies, I could not find the column CBE in the database. I will proceed with the rest of the query.

Here is the SQL query based on the available information:

```sql
WITH DynastyArtifactCounts AS
  (SELECT artdynasty AS Dynasty,
          COUNT(artregistry) FILTER (WHERE cam.budgetallocstatus = 'Adequate') AS AdequateFundingCount,
          COUNT(artregistry) FILTER (WHERE cam.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient') AS InsufficientFundingCount
   FROM artifactscore AS ac
   LEFT JOIN conservationandmaintenance AS cam ON ac.artregistry = cam.artrefmaintained
   GROUP BY artdynasty),
     DynastyPriorityScores AS
  (SELECT artdynasty AS Dynasty,
          SUM(conservepriorityscore) AS TotalPriorityScore
   FROM artifactscore AS ac
   JOIN riskassessments AS ra ON ac.artregistry = ra.artrefconcerned
   GROUP BY artdynasty),
     BudgetEfficiency AS
  (SELECT artdynasty AS Dynasty,
          AVG(CASE
                  WHEN cam.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 0
                  ELSE 1
              END) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue
   FROM artifactscore AS ac
   LEFT JOIN conservationandmaintenance AS cam ON ac.artregistry = cam.artrefmaintained
   GROUP BY artdynasty),
     BudgetStatus AS
  (SELECT artdynasty AS Dynasty,
          CASE
              WHEN MAX(cam.budgetallocstatus) = 'Insufficient' THEN 'Budget Crisis'
              ELSE 'Within Budget'
          END AS BudgetStatus
   FROM artifactscore AS ac
   LEFT JOIN conservationandmaintenance AS cam ON ac.artregistry = cam.artrefmaintained
   GROUP BY artdynasty)
SELECT d.Dynasty,
       COALESCE(dps.TotalPriorityScore, 0) AS TotalPriorityScore,
       COALESCE(dac.AdequateFundingCount, 0) AS AdequateFundingCount,
       COALESCE(dac.InsufficientFundingCount, 0) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
       COALESCE(be.BudgetEfficiencyValue, 0) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
       COALESCE(bs.BudgetStatus, 'Within Budget') AS BudgetStatus
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT artdynasty AS Dynasty
   FROM artifactscore) d
LEFT JOIN DynastyArtifactCounts dac ON d.Dynasty = dac.Dynasty
LEFT JOIN DynastyPriorityScores dps ON d.Dynasty = dps.Dynasty
LEFT JOIN BudgetEfficiency be ON d.Dynasty = be.Dynasty
LEFT JOIN BudgetStatus bs ON d.Dynasty = bs.Dynasty
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ALL DYNASTIES',
       SUM(COALESCE(dps.TotalPriorityScore, 0)),
       SUM(COALESCE(dac.AdequateFundingCount, 0)),
       SUM(COALESCE(dac.InsufficientFundingCount, 0)),
       AVG(COALESCE(be.BudgetEfficiencyValue, 0)),
       CASE
           WHEN MAX(bs.BudgetStatus) = 'Budget Crisis' THEN 'Budget Crisis'
           ELSE 'Within Budget'
       END
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT artdynasty AS Dynasty
   FROM artifactscore) d
LEFT JOIN DynastyArtifactCounts dac ON d.Dynasty = dac.Dynasty
LEFT JOIN DynastyPriorityScores dps ON d.Dynasty = dps.Dynasty
LEFT JOIN BudgetEfficiency be ON d.Dynasty = be.Dynasty
LEFT JOIN BudgetStatus bs ON d.Dynasty = bs.Dynasty;
```
